[[File:Obi-Wan_Kenobi-cold_weather_gear_figure.jpg|250px|thumb|Kenobi in his cold weather gear]]
A '''cold weather suit''' was used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when he was still a young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. That parka was in fact of ancient make and had been passed down from generation to generation of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before it came to Kenobi.

Lined with woven metallic fibers, the quilted Jedi suit kept its wearer warm in frigid condition while also protecting them from blows. Kenobi notably wore that parka when he was sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to investigate the tundra of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] in search of a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]. He wore it with a pair of custom-fitted ice [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with talon-like metal crampons and a pair of tinted goggles.
